# Mana Adda™ — India's Daily Labour, Organized

> Mana Adda™ is an on-demand blue-collar labor marketplace and digital infrastructure platform digitizing India's informal daily wage labor economy. Tagline: "మన పని. మన భద్రత. మన పైసా." (Our Work. Our Safety. Our Money.) Powered by NextMetaForce.

## Core Value Proposition
- **For Daily Wage Workers**: Browse nearby Adda jobs, receive GPS-verified check-ins, benefit from free accidental shift insurance, and get direct 100% end-of-day (EOD) UPI settlements to PhonePe, Google Pay, or Paytm. Zero middleman cuts.
- **For Contractors & Builders**: Post daily batch labor requirements, ensure 100% site workforce arrival with GPS verification, lock shift wages in secure Razorpay Escrow, and download digital GST audit ledgers.
- **Dual-Context Architecture**: Allows senior masons and workers to switch between Worker Mode (Laborer) and Hirer Mode (Contractor) in 1-tap without changing accounts.

## Key Technical & Financial Safeguards
- **1-Tap GPS Attendance**: Real-time native GPS verification cross-referenced with site pins to eliminate proxy disputes.
- **Razorpay Escrow Vault**: Pre-funded batch wages safely locked before work begins and automatically disbursed at end of day.
- **Direct EOD UPI Payouts**: Automated instant transfers straight to worker UPI accounts without cash friction.
- **Free Shift Insurance**: Every morning check-in activates accidental insurance cover safeguarding daily wage families.

## Hyderabad Geographic Coverage (31 Master Addas)
- **Central & West**: Jubilee Hills Check Post, Yousufguda, Panjagutta, Ameerpet, Banjara Hills Rd 12, Tolichowki, Mehdipatnam.
- **Cyberabad IT Corridor**: Gachibowli, Kondapur, Chanda Nagar, Lingampally, Miyapur, Kukatpally Y-Junction, Balanagar.
- **Secunderabad Zone**: Secunderabad Station Kummarguda, Tarnaka, ECIL, Alwal, Suchitra Junction, Chintal.
- **East & South-East**: LB Nagar, Dilsukhnagar, Uppal Ring Road, Nagole, Ramanthapur, Hastinapuram.
- **Old City & South**: Koti Labour Adda, Charminar Gulzar Houz, Nampally Station, Santosh Nagar, Attapur Pillar 120.
